items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: Spider Ridgeway was a good drummer... So we were getting ready to go on this tour... We played and we ended up playing in Atlanta in the underground.

ctx.x: Herman Foretich, his nickname was “Dirty Shirt” it seemed like he never changed his shirt. But Spider Ridgeway was a good drummer. I mean he knew how to play trad. He could lay it on you and just make you play, you know, one of those drummers. And he was also a hopeless drunk. I mean he’d get started drinking and he’s gone for the weekend. So we were getting ready to go on this tour which — I don’t have this either , one of these days I’ve got to get it. But I think I’ve got a tape somewhere. Wow. Billy Allred.
